messages:
Maria: dropping an alternate compact timeline today - tries to balance density and affordance. calling it mini-timeline v1. feedback pls. Figma link: figma.com/...
Priya: looks promising. my main worry is discoverability of variants when allocations are <3%. tiny visual slice is easy to miss on retina screens.
Jake: Could we add a subtle halo on focus and a light stroke on hover? Also tap targets must be 44px on mobile.
Maria: plan: keep visual slices small for density, but use invisible hit area to meet 44px. Halo for keyboard focus, with strong contrast.
Aisha: accessibility checklist: 1) each slice needs aria-label that contains variant name + % + start time. 2) role=button and tabindex=0. 3) when allocations change, announce via aria-live region. 4) respect prefers-reduced-motion for scrubber transitions.
Sam: what about rollback action? In the dense view users might accidentally open menu. Maybe long-press for mobile rollback?
Priya: long-press conflicts with OS gestures. prefer explicit overflow menu on details panel. Inline quick actions can be Promote only; Rollback off the menu.
Lee: microcopy: "Promote" vs "Increase traffic" debate again. Suggest "Promote variant" for clarity, and add a confirm modal that states "This will route X% more traffic to Variant B".
Maria: agree on explicit sentence in confirmation. Also thinking of an undo window (10s toast with "Undo") after promote/rollback. Ops wanted link to live deployment logs from the toast.
Jake: For small slices, tooltip should be terse: "B — 3%". Full details in panel. Tooltips must be keyboard accessible (focusable).
Aisha: color contrast: selection halo currently 3.2:1 on dark bg; needs to meet 4.5:1 for body text. Propose using a 2px white ring + 1px brand accent outer to improve perceived contrast. Also check focus visible when high-contrast mode on Windows.
Sam: motion: prefer crossfade not slide. And when scrubber auto-scrolls, don't reannounce the whole timeline to SR users, only the newly focused slice.
Priya: localization note: avoid verbs in tooltip (short nouns and numbers) to simplify translations. Keep tooltip pattern consistent across locales.
Maria: Ok action items: - make hit area 44px; - add numeric overlay and terse tooltip pattern; - keep Promote as "Promote variant"; - rollback only via menu + confirm modal; - add 10s undo toast with logs link; - implement aria-live polite updates and reduced-motion fallback; - update Figma + components.
designbot: Design review requested by Maria for `mini-timeline-v1`. Reviewers: Priya, Jake, Aisha, Sam, Lee. Deadline: 5 business days.
Maria: thanks, will push updated mocks into the design system and tag engineering for implementation notes (keyboard sequence, aria labels, reduced-motion tests). Ping when you review the tokens.
